title: Dua during Rukoo
arabic: اللّهُـمَّ لَكَ رَكَـعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَـنْت، ولَكَ أَسْلَـمْت ، خَشَـعَ لَكَ سَمْـعي، وَبَصَـري ، وَمُخِّـي، وَعَظْمـي، وَعَصَـبي ، وَما استَقَـلَّ بِهِ قَدَمي
transliteration: Allāhumma laka raka'tu, wa bika 'āmantu, wa laka 'aslamtu khasha'a laka sam'ee wa baṣarī, wa mukhkhī, wa 'aẓmī, wa 'aṣabī, wa mastaqalla bihi qadamī.
translation: O Allah, to You I bow (in prayer) and in You I believe and to You I have submitted. Before You my hearing is humbled, and my sight, and my mind, my bones, my nerves and what my feet have mounted upon (for travel).
